rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, and executed exchanges/modifications via the tools. However, policy requires confirming every order-changing action before performing it. The agent proceeded to exchange delivered items and modify a pending order without any explicit customer confirmation. Additionally, the final message only reports the grill modification and refund, with no confirmation or outcome details about the helmet and luggage exchanges the user requested. Acting on the user’s own orders seems fine, and authentication by name/ZIP was attempted, but the lack of pre-write confirmation and incomplete communication of results violate the pass criteria.
